about: Engineers India Limited, an engineering consultancy company, provides design, engineering, procurement, construction, and integrated project management services for oil, gas, fertilizers, steel, railways, power, infrastructure, and petrochemical industries worldwide. The company operates through two segments, Consultancy & Engineering Projects, and Turnkey Projects.
